explication: dsh-pet is a DeepSeek Harness desktop-pet plugin with browser overlay and optional Electron windows. The user configures pet instances, then the client renders animations and interactions; host services provide configuration, balance, chat, whisper, work-status, and notification data. The README documents major capabilities beyond the sampled excerpts, including animation packs, multi-display movement, and session-linked states. Dashed edges mark desktop renderer wiring not directly shown in the excerpts; other links cite source or README evidence.
